_comment: Single source of truth for all conductor hooks. lib/hooks_manifest.py reads this; tests/test_hooks_manifest.py asserts every entry has a matching script and every script in hooks/ is registered. Adding a new hook? Add its file AND its entry here in the same commit.

hooks.name: pre_phase0_readonly.py
hooks.description: Phase 0 strict read-only enforcement. Blocks Write/Edit/mutating-Bash outside .conductor/ when state.gate is the Phase 0 scan.

hooks.name: pre_first_response_gate.py
hooks.description: First Response hard gate. Blocks Write/Edit/Task/mutating-Bash before user replies 'proceed'. Overrides accept-edits mode.

hooks.name: pre_busy_wait_block.py
hooks.description: Forbids busy-wait Bash (until/while-do-sleep, leading sleep N>=100). Use ScheduleWakeup or file-mtime polling instead.

hooks.name: pre_lock_enforcement.py
hooks.description: Lock enforcement. Blocks Write/Edit to files outside the active task's declared files_write[]. Tolerant pre-Phase D (no enforcement until active-task.json::files_write is populated).

hooks.name: post_output_quality.py
hooks.description: Output-quality completeness check. Inspects structured outputs (CSV/JSON/XLSX/Parquet) and flags column-empty, row-empty, or low fill-rate to findings.md.

hooks.name: stop_validate_final_report.py
hooks.description: FINAL_REPORT validator. At session end with phase==complete, verifies FINAL_REPORT.md contains all required sections; flags missing sections to findings.md.

hooks.name: pre_state_committed.py
hooks.description: Advisory: warns once per session if .conductor/ is in .gitignore — breaks v6 'every task is replayable' promise. Logs to findings.md, never blocks.

hooks.name: pre_spec_split_enforce.py
hooks.description: Blocks Read of spec-shaped files >300 lines without spec-parts/manifest.json present. Closes a measurable Claude-degradation path. Paginated reads (limit<=500) and an opt-out marker (.conductor/.spec-split-skipped) are allowed.

hooks.name: stop_evidence_completeness_check.py
hooks.description: Advisory: at session end, flags v6 evidence/tasks/<id>/ folders with manifest.json but missing/empty commit_sha. Deduplicated across runs by hash of the failing-task set.

hooks.name: heartbeat.py
hooks.description: Writes .conductor/heartbeat.json after every tool call so parent agents can read background-mode status without spawning a second conductor.

hooks.name: usage_limit_wakeup.py
hooks.description: Detects API usage-limit / rate-limit errors in tool output, writes .conductor/usage-limit-paused.json with a recommended ScheduleWakeup time.
